title: Bound States in Exactly Solvable Polaritonic Models
abstract: We study a one-dimensional scalar model for an effective-mass quasiparticle field coupled to a continuum of two-level atoms with at most one excitation present. We prove a general theorem on the existence of bound states under sign-definite spatially localized perturbations of constant atomic density and analyze the bound states for several exactly solvable examples.

bite.hook: Researchers discover exact mathematical formulas for bound states in a one-dimensional quantum model.
tldr: Studied a one-dimensional scalar model for a quasiparticle coupled to a continuum of atoms.
Proved a general mathematical theorem regarding the existence of bound states under localized perturbations.
Analyzed these bound states explicitly for several exactly solvable examples.
bite.whyItMatters: Exact solutions in quantum physics are rare goldmines that allow scientists to test assumptions without making approximations.
bite.eli5: Imagine throwing a ball in a room where it can either bounce around freely forever or get stuck in a valley. The authors found exact mathematical rules for when particles get trapped in these valleys.
